title: VNG Annual Report 2025 — Zalo & AI
claim: Operational scorecard reports 79.6M MAU, 2.11B daily messages and about 150k OA business-solutions coverage. Priorities include Vietnamese/local AI applicability, AI-first utilities, service reliability and internal productivity.
limitations: Corporate self-report, not an independent product benchmark. Page has inconsistent 8%/9% daily-message growth prose and a typo in Kiki scorecard; those growth figures are not used. Does not expose internal support volume, incident rates or private workflows.

title: Zalo và Google hợp tác ra mắt Trung tâm an toàn số bảo vệ người dùng Việt
published_on_or_unknown: not visible in fetched primary body
event_date_or_unknown: text says distribution begins in August that year; exact year not established by primary body
claim: Zalo and Google already provide a Safety Center covering scams, malicious links/files, impersonation, financial caution, reporting, 2FA and privacy controls.
limitations: Does not prove efficacy of a particular control or measured fraud reduction. Search metadata/secondary stories suggest 2026, but this ledger does not treat exact launch date as verified from the fetched primary body.

title: Zalopay thí điểm cảnh báo tài khoản nhận tiền nghi ngờ gian lận
claim: Zalopay pilots transfer warnings using internal fraud data plus SIMO/NAPAS/SBV information, including suspicious recipient accounts and identity mismatches. Warnings are decision-support, not a declaration of fraud.
limitations: No public third-party API access for NORA was established. Pilot scope at announcement is not proof of current universal coverage or known false-positive/negative rates.

title: Zalo Help — Đề phòng chiêu trò mạo danh hợp tác với Zalo để lừa đảo
published_on_or_unknown: search metadata 2025-10-28; no visible date in fetched body
claim: Documents fake Zalo partnerships, fake desktop rewards/installers, lookalike sites requesting credentials/OTP, account takeover and propagation to contacts; identifies official channels and recovery guidance.
limitations: Confirms scam patterns, not incident prevalence, VNG system compromise, or effectiveness of NORA. HTTPS alone is not identity proof; recommendations need full origin checks.

title: Zalo OA — Xác thực và ủy quyền cho Ứng dụng
claim: OA must link and authorize an app; OAuth v4 uses PKCE and OA-admin consent. Permission groups are explicit. Access token lifetime is 25h; refresh token rotates on use and old access token is invalidated on refresh. Token exchange and refresh both require the app secret_key header despite PKCE.
limitations: OA authority is not arbitrary personal-account message access. Requires actual OA/app setup, approvals, scope and production validation; no integration was created in this research. A distributed desktop client must not embed a shared application secret; server/BFF token brokerage is a design consequence, not an implemented service.

title: Zalo OA — Tin nhắn tổng quan
claim: OA messaging is enterprise OA to personal user. Consultation messages need eligible interaction within 7 days and a non-blocked OA; first 48h are free, subsequent eligible consultation messages follow pricing. GMF and ZBS templates have separate conditions.
limitations: Eligibility, pricing and quota may change. Does not authorize bulk outreach or reading unrelated personal conversations. Do not use legacy V2 examples as current production contract.

title: Zalo Help — Tài khoản bị tạm thời vô hiệu hóa
published_on_or_unknown: search metadata 2023-03-06; current body has no visible date
claim: Reasons for temporary disabling include automated/bot accounts, emulators and third-party software not issued by Zalo, as well as abnormal or abusive activity.
limitations: Not a blanket legal opinion about every accessibility tool, but a material product-policy risk for unofficial personal-account scraping/automation. Need official integration or explicit partner approval.

title: Zalo Help — Báo xấu tài khoản Zalo
published_on_or_unknown: search metadata 2023-07-18; fetched body no visible date
claim: User reports can include text/voice messages, images/video/links and screenshots. Zalo asks for specific evidence and states it reviews reports; not every report leads to removal.
limitations: No public reporting API verified. Stated 7–10-day process is guidance, not an observed SLA or measured average. Cannot infer incomplete-report rate or support staffing cost.

title: Zalo OA — Tự động hóa chăm sóc khách hàng với Zalo Chatbot
claim: OA already offers paid chatbot flows/rules, FAQs, information collection, routing/notifications to staff and dynamic backend data such as order status. Third-party chatbots can integrate.
limitations: Marketing benefits are not measured causal results. Generic FAQ/RAG or order-status chatbot would substantially overlap existing functionality; does not prove any proposed NORA task is unique.

title: Zalo — Kiki Info
claim: Kiki Info is already an OA AI assistant for broad Q&A, traffic information, content drafting and recommendations; company reports over 1M visits in under two months.
limitations: Company self-reported adoption and feature description. Not a comparative quality/safety benchmark or proof of tool-use breadth.

title: Zalo — Kiki Auto
event_date_or_unknown: late 2024 install milestone; Premium announced from August 2025
claim: Kiki Auto already prioritizes Vietnamese navigation/music with regional accents; Premium adds traffic alerts, fine lookup, AI news and saved destinations.
limitations: Popularity/quality claims are vendor marketing; no independent benchmark examined here. Generic local-language voice interaction is not a fresh differentiator by itself.

title: VNG FY2025 audited results press release
claim: VNG describes AI used across customer care, translation, reviews and LiveOps; 30% Zalo MAU used at least one AI feature. AI-first strategy and enterprise/cloud growth are explicit.
limitations: Does not establish a broken internal helpdesk or confidential process failure. Corporate claims, not causal proof of AI benefits or permission to access internal data.

title: Zalopay — nâng cấp bảo mật theo Thông tư 77/2025/TT-NHNN
claim: Zalopay says its app may exit/stop on unsafe environments including rooted/jailbroken devices, emulators/VMs/debugging/ADB conditions or repackaged apps.
limitations: This is the provider's product notice, not a full independent legal interpretation or every platform's compatibility matrix. Do not propose bypasses to enable NORA payment automation.

title: Zalopay statement about CIC incident independence
event_date_or_unknown: CIC incident 2025-09-11 as cited by provider
claim: Zalopay states it has no connection/data transfer to CIC and its customers were not affected by that incident. It warns of incident-themed impersonation and says it never requests passwords/OTP/card data by phone/email/social media.
limitations: Provider assertion is not independent breach verification. Must not turn this into an allegation VNG/Zalopay was breached; this source explicitly says otherwise.

title: Zalo OA API error codes
claim: Documents unauthorized scopes, expired tokens, quotas, app/OA disabling, messaging eligibility and MessageV2 shutdown in favor of MessageV3 (-240).
limitations: A client must verify exact endpoints/version and handle errors rather than assume rights. Error list alone is not a completed integration or exhaustive security control.

title: Zalo/Google Safety Center landing page
claim: Existing safety hub presents scam awareness, 2FA/privacy tools and reporting routes.
limitations: A landing page does not establish model performance, false-positive rates or program-wide reach. Closely related to VNG02, not an independent confirmation of efficacy.
